title: Nmap Network Scanning Essentials
content: Nmap (Network Mapper) is an open-source tool for network discovery and security auditing. Key command syntax: `nmap -sS -p 1-65535 -T4 -v <target>` (SYN Stealth Scan across all ports); `nmap -sV -sC <target>` (Service version detection and default NSE scripts); `nmap -O <target>` (OS fingerprinting); `nmap -Pn <target>` (Treat all hosts as online, bypass ping probe). Evasion techniques include packet fragmentation (`-f`) and decoy scanning (`-D`).

title: Wireshark Packet Analysis & PCAP Filtering
content: Wireshark is a network packet analyzer. Essential display filters: `ip.addr == 192.168.1.1` (Filter by IP); `tcp.flags.syn == 1 && tcp.flags.ack == 0` (Identify TCP SYN packets / port scan attempts); `http.request.method == "POST"` (Find HTTP POST requests); `dns.flags.response == 0` (Find DNS queries); `tls.handshake.type == 1` (Client Hello TLS handshake). Follow TCP Stream feature reconstructs complete conversations.

title: TCP 3-Way Handshake & Connection Teardown
content: TCP connection establishment follows the 3-Way Handshake: 1) Client sends `SYN` (Synchronize) with initial sequence number (ISN); 2) Server responds with `SYN-ACK` (Synchronize-Acknowledge); 3) Client replies with `ACK` (Acknowledge). Connection termination uses `FIN` or `RST` packets. Attack vectors include SYN Flooding (DoS attack exhausting connection queue space) mitigated by SYN Cookies.
